newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end higher.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end higher.

text.p: Jan 9 - Most U.S. stock index futures ended higher. March S&Ps climbed to fresh highs late in the day on light short-covering. Some traders were covering short positions. Others limited exposure overall ahead of U.S. labor data on Friday. Arbitrage buy programs were noted in the afternoon. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
